components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Lets an Original with the werewolf gene become an Original hybrid, or frees a bound hybrid so that it can shift again.

Full-moon night only. The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does); a villager and a wolf must stand in the circle: they are the sacrifice, and they are killed. Werewolves must be installed.
Anyone else is refused: the caster is told only that the rite would change nothing, and the ingredients come back.
